notes: §1985:VII.4.3.4 GR10: "The NO REWIND and REVERSED phrases will be ignored if they do not apply to the storage medium on which the file resides." FileRegistry#NoRewindPhraseEffect runs NO REWIND as a plain open on every (non-reel/unit) medium and overlays status 07 on a successful one; SequentialConnector#OpenCore marks a REVERSED open of a stream that cannot seek as inapplicable, so ReversedPhraseEffect/PositionReversed leave it reading forward, and on a positionable file honour REVERSED (GR11c, GR12); CheckOpenTapePhrase admits the phrases at 85 only (COBOL0902 from 2002). The prior PARTIAL (REVERSED on a FIFO gave 30 on every READ) is fixed by kb/Work PB5199 (landed). Probes at --std 85: e) under WSL with the same build, a FIFO holding REC1REC2REC3 opened INPUT REVERSED reads REC1 REC2 REC3 with 00 (open 00), as the plain open does, and WITH NO REWIND gives open 07 and the same records; a regular file REVERSED reads REC3 REC2 REC1 then 10; disk OPEN INPUT/OUTPUT WITH NO REWIND give 07 and position at the start; an absent file REVERSED or NO REWIND gives 35 and the next READ 47 with no AT END run; an absent OPTIONAL file gives 05 (REVERSED) and 07 (NO REWIND, both values apply and §1985:VII.1.3.5 leaves the choice to the implementor), then AT END 10; b) OPEN I-O and EXTEND WITH NO REWIND COBOL1803, OUTPUT REVERSED COBOL2211, REVERSED NO REWIND together COBOL2269, REVERSED on a relative file COBOL2210 (SR1); c) REVERSED at 2002 COBOL0902, LINE SEQUENTIAL at 85 COBOL0900. a), d) and f) do not reach this rule. The witness is the NO REWIND half on a disk file. History: until the 1985 re-read 5 (2026-11-14) this row read PARTIAL, naming no kb/Work note; the re-read of main dc1f2dcce8 found that defect fixed by the landing of kb/Work PB5199 and records CONFORMS, upheld by an independent refuter (code read: op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-11.json, refuter op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-11-refute.json).

next.reason: 1985 GR10: 'The NO REWIND and REVERSED phrases will be ignored if they do not apply to the storage medium'. 2023 keeps the NO REWIND half: §2023:14.9.27.4 GR11 'The NO REWIND phrase will be ignored if it does not apply to the storage medium' (OPEN successful, status '07', as §2023:9.1.13.2 GR6 and 1985 status 07 both say). REVERSED (obsolete in 1985 4.3.1) is absent from the 2023 OPEN format §2023:14.9.27.2 and every 2023 OPEN rule, so the REVERSED case of this rule has no 2023 counterpart: a case removed.
